name: @platform/site
description: Read about Destack on its website, documentation and blog.

scripts.build: bun run generate && bun run build/main.ts build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format-check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.dev: bun run generate && bun run build/main.ts dev
scripts.format: destack-check format src build scripts content.ts
scripts.format-check: destack-check format-check src build scripts content.ts
scripts.lint: destack-check check src build scripts content.ts
scripts.test: bun run scripts/test-highlighting.ts && bun run scripts/test-markdown.ts
scripts.generate: bun run scripts/generate-release.ts && bun run scripts/generate-pricing.ts && bun run scripts/generate-headword.ts
